# nautobot_vlan_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves information about all VLAN groups in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nautobot_vlan_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vlan_groups` (Attributes List) List of VLAN groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlan_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--vlan_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan_groups`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) VLAN group creation date (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) VLAN group description.
- `display` (String) Human-friendly display value for the VLAN group.
- `id` (String) VLAN group UUID.
- `last_updated` (String) VLAN group last update date (RFC3339).
- `location_id` (String) UUID of the location associated with the VLAN group.
- `name` (String) VLAN group name.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the VLAN group.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the VLAN group.
- `range` (String) Permitted VLAN IDs as a comma-separated list of ranges.
- `tags_ids` (List of String) UUIDs of tags associated with the VLAN group.
- `url` (String) API URL of the VLAN group.
- `vlan_count` (Number) Number of VLANs in the VLAN group.
